info.name: Atur Perjalanan API
info.description:
REST API collection for Atur Perjalanan backend (NestJS).

**Milestone coverage:** M3 — Health, Auth, Users | M4 — Trips & Invitations | M5 — Voting | M6 — Activities | M7 — Chat & Media

## Setup
1. Import this collection and `atur-perjalanan-local.postman_environment.json`
2. Select the **Atur Perjalanan — Local** environment
3. Set `google_id_token` in the environment (from Google Sign-In on mobile/web)
4. Run **Auth → Google Sign-In** — test script saves `access_token` automatically
5. For new users, run **Complete Registration** before other authenticated requests

## Two-user testing (invitations, voting, chat)
Some flows need two people at once (invite → accept, multi-voter tallies, multi-user chat). This collection keeps **two independent sessions** so you never have to log out and back in:

- **User 1** uses `access_token` (the default Bearer auth for every request).
- **User 2** uses `access_token_2`. Requests suffixed **(User 2)** override their auth to use it.

Steps:
1. Set both `google_id_token` and `google_id_token_2` in the environment.
2. Run **Auth → Google Sign-In** and **Auth → Google Sign-In (User 2)** — each saves its own token.
3. (New users) run **Complete Registration** and **Complete Registration (User 2)**.
4. Typical flows:
   - **Invitations:** Invite User (User 1) → Get My Invitations (User 2) → Accept Invitation (User 2).
   - **Voting:** Vote on Poll (User 1) + Vote on Poll (User 2).
   - **Chat:** Send Text Message (User 1) → List Messages (User 2) → Send Text Message (User 2) → Mark Chat Read (User 2).

## Variables
| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `base_url` | API base URL (default `http://localhost:8080/v1`) |
| `google_id_token` / `google_id_token_2` | Google OAuth ID token for User 1 / User 2 |
| `access_token` / `access_token_2` | App JWT for User 1 / User 2 (auto-saved after sign-in) |
| `realtime_token` / `realtime_token_2` | Supabase-compatible JWT for Realtime WebSocket (User 1 / User 2) |
| `username` / `username_2` | Username for User 1 / User 2 |
| `trip_id` | Trip UUID — set after Create Trip or copy from List Trips |
| `invitation_id` | Invitation UUID for respond/cancel |
| `poll_id` / `option_id` / `candidate_id` | Voting IDs (copy from List Polls response) |
| `activity_id` | Activity UUID for get/update/delete |
| `member_id` | User UUID of trip member to remove |
| `message_id` / `message_id_2` | Chat message UUID (auto-saved; User 1 / User 2) |
| `document_id` | Media document UUID (auto-saved from List Documents) |
| `storage_key` | R2 object key from Presign Upload (auto-saved) |
| `cursor` | Pagination cursor — RFC3339 timestamp from `next_cursor` in list responses |

## Pagination (`cursor`)
List endpoints (messages, trips, users, …) return `next_cursor` when more pages exist. To fetch the **next page**, copy `next_cursor` into the `cursor` query param and re-run the list request. Leave `cursor` empty for the first page. Chat messages use **RFC3339 timestamps** (e.g. `2026-07-13T04:28:14.108Z`), not UUIDs.

## Error format
```json
{ "error": { "code": "ERROR_CODE", "message": "..." }, "requestId": "..." }
```

item.name: Health
item.description: Infrastructure health check (M2/M3). No authentication required.

request.description:
Returns server health status.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "status": "ok", "timestamp": "2026-07-12T12:00:00.000Z" }
```

Verify Google ID token and sign in / register user.

**Auth:** None (public)

**Body:**
- `id_token` (string, required) — Google OAuth ID token

**Response:**
```json
{
  "access_token": "...",
  "realtime_token": "...",
  "is_new_user": false,
  "user": { "id": "...", "name": "...", "username": "...", ... }
}
```

`user` is omitted when `is_new_user` is `true` — call **Complete Registration** next.

**Errors:** `401` invalid Google token

Set username for a newly registered user.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Body:**
- `username` (string, required) — 3–30 chars, `[a-zA-Z0-9_]+`

**Response:**
```json
{ "user": { "id": "...", "username": "...", ... } }
```

**Errors:** `409 USERNAME_TAKEN`, `400 USERNAME_INVALID`

Sign in the **second** test user. Saves the returned JWT to `access_token_2` (and `realtime_token_2`) so you can act as two users at once without re-logging in.

Set `google_id_token_2` in the environment to User 2's Google ID token before running.

Use `{{access_token_2}}` as the Bearer token in any request you want to send *as User 2* (several ready-made variants are included in the Invitations and Voting folders).
Set the username for the **second** newly-registered user. Authenticated as User 2 (`{{access_token_2}}`).

item.name: Users
item.description: User profile, search, and public profile endpoints (M3).

request.description:
Check if a username is available (real-time validation during onboarding).

**Auth:** None (public)

**Query:**
- `username` (required)

**Response:**
```json
{ "username": "johndoe", "available": true }
```

Search users by name or username (pg_trgm).

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Query:**
- `q` (required, min 1 char)
- `cursor` (optional, UUID)
- `limit` (optional, default 20, max 100)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "data": [{ "id": "...", "name": "...", "username": "...", "avatar_url": null, "trip_count": 0 }],
  "next_cursor": null
}
```

Get the authenticated user's profile.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Response:** `UserProfile`
```json
{
  "id": "...",
  "name": "...",
  "username": "...",
  "avatar_url": null,
  "bio": null,
  "website_url": null,
  "location_label": null,
  "is_public": true,
  "trip_count": 0,
  "created_at": "..."
}
```

Update the authenticated user's profile.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Body (all optional):**
- `bio` (string, max 150)
- `website_url` (valid URL, max 255)
- `location_label` (string, max 100)
- `is_public` (boolean)

**Response:** Updated `UserProfile`

Permanently delete the authenticated user's account.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Response:** `204 No Content` (empty body)

Get a user's public profile by username.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Path:**
- `username` (string)

**Response:** `UserProfile`

**Errors:**
- `404 USER_NOT_FOUND`
- `403 PROFILE_PRIVATE` (private profile, viewer is not owner)

List trips for a user (privacy-aware).

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Path:**
- `username` (string)

**Query:**
- `cursor` (optional, trip UUID)
- `limit` (optional, default 20, max 100)

**Response:**
```json
{
  "data": [{ "id": "...", "name": "...", "status": "fixed", ... }],
  "next_cursor": null
}
```

Owner sees all trips; non-owner sees only `is_public: true` trips.

**Errors:** `404 USER_NOT_FOUND`

item.name: Trips
item.description: Trip CRUD and management (M4). Create trips in fixed or voting mode, invite users, manage members, set cover.

exec: pm.test('Response has trip ID and name', function () {

request.description:
Create a new trip in fixed (certain dates) or voting (candidate dates) mode.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (required)

**Body:**
- `name` (string, required, max 255)
- `tags` (string[], optional)
- `start_date` & `end_date` for fixed mode OR `candidates` array (1-3 items) for voting mode

**Response:** Trip object with id, status (fixed|voting_pending), and voting_deadline if voting mode
List trips for the authenticated user with enriched data (participant_count, participants_preview, cover_image_url).
Get details of a specific trip. Must be creator, participant, or invited user.
Update trip details. Creator only.
Soft-delete a trip. Creator only. Returns 204 No Content.
Set or update trip cover image. Creator only. Document must exist in this trip.

Members screen payload (WORKFLOW §11). Returns `{ is_creator, members[], invitations[] }`.

- `members[]`: active participants — `{ id, name, username, avatar_url, joined_at, role: creator|member }`
- `invitations[]`: outstanding invites (pending + declined) — `{ id, method, status, state, invited_user, invited_email, invited_by, created_at }` where `state` is `email_sent` | `pending_accept` | `rejected`. Use `state=rejected` rows for the "Undang kembali" action; use `invited_user`/`invited_email` to mark already-invited rows in search results.

Any member may view. `is_creator` gates the "Keluarkan" button.
Remove a member from trip. Creator only. Returns 204 No Content.

item.name: Invitations
item.description: Trip invitation management — invite users, respond to invitations, cancel pending invites (M4).

request.description: List pending invitations for the current user, enriched with trip and inviter summaries.

Invite a user to a trip via username or email. Only trip participants can invite. Provide exactly one of: `username` or `email`.

Also serves as **re-invite ("Undang kembali")**: if the target has a `declined`/`cancelled` invitation, it is reactivated to `pending` (no duplicate row). Returns `409 INVITATION_EXISTS` only if a `pending` invite already exists, `409 ALREADY_PARTICIPANT` if already a member.
Accept or decline a trip invitation. Set accept to true/false. Returns 204 No Content.
Cancel a pending invitation. Inviter only. Returns 204 No Content.

List pending invitations **for User 2** (`{{access_token_2}}`). Run this after User 1 invites User 2 to grab the `invitation_id` to accept.

Tip: add a test script to auto-save `invitation_id` from `data[0].id` if you like.

Accept (or decline) the invitation **as User 2** (`{{access_token_2}}`) — no login switch needed. Set `accept` to true/false. Returns 204 No Content.

Typical flow: **Invite User** (as User 1) → **Get My Invitations (User 2)** → **Accept Invitation (User 2)**.

item.name: Voting
item.description: Multi-poll voting for trip dates, activities, and other options (M5).

request.description:
List all polls for a trip with vote tallies and current user vote.

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "poll-1",
      "poll_type": "aktivitas",
      "title": "Best Activity",
      "status": "active",
      "deadline": null,
      "locked_at": null,
      "creator": { "id": "user-1", "name": "Alice", "username": "alice", "avatar_url": null },
      "options": [
        { "id": "opt-1", "label": "Hiking", "sort_order": 0, "candidate_id": null, "vote_count": 2 },
        { "id": "opt-2", "label": "Swimming", "sort_order": 1, "candidate_id": null, "vote_count": 1 }
      ],
      "voted_option_id": "opt-1",
      "created_at": "2026-07-12T12:00:00.000Z"
    }
  ],
  "next_cursor": null
}
```

Create a new poll (aktivitas or lainnya). Tanggal polls are auto-created when trip enters voting_pending. Creator only.

**Request body:**
- `title` (string): Poll title
- `poll_type` ('aktivitas' | 'lainnya'): Poll type
- `options` (string[]): 2–10 option labels
- `deadline` (ISO 8601 string, optional): Vote deadline

**Response 201:** Poll object with empty vote counts.

**Errors:**
- 400: Fewer than 2 options, tanggal poll creation attempt, > 10 options
- 409: Active poll already exists for this poll_type

Vote on a poll option. Replaces previous vote if voter already voted. No-op if voting for same option. Set `poll_id` and `option_id` (real UUIDs from **List Polls**) in the environment first.

**Response 204:** No Content.

Retract the current user's vote on a poll.

**Response 204:** No Content.

Vote on a date candidate. Separate from generic polls (tanggal poll voting). Set `candidate_id` (real UUID) in the environment first.

**Response 204:** No Content.

Retract the current user's vote on a date candidate.

**Response 204:** No Content.

Lock a poll (creator only). If tanggal poll, updates trip dates to winning candidate and sets trip status to 'fixed'.

**Response 204:** No Content.

**Errors:**
- 403: Not the trip creator
Delete an active poll (creator only). Response 204: No Content. Errors: 400 Poll not active, 403 Not the trip creator

Cast a vote **as User 2** (`{{access_token_2}}`) — lets you build up a real tally with two voters without switching login. User 2 must be a participant of the trip (accept the invitation first). Set `poll_id` and `option_id` from **List Polls**.

**Response 204:** No Content.

Retract User 2's vote on a poll (`{{access_token_2}}`).

**Response 204:** No Content.

item.name: Activities
item.description: CRUD endpoints for trip itinerary activities (M6).

request.description: List all activities for a trip, grouped by date and sorted by start_time. Response 200: Array of activity objects with place_name, times, kind, cover info.
Get a single activity by ID. Set `activity_id` (real UUID) in the environment first. Response 200: Activity detail object.
Create a new activity. Participants can create. Validation: times must be HH:MM, start_time <= end_time, activity_date within trip range if fixed. Response 201: Activity detail.
Update an activity (partial update supported). Response 200: Updated activity object.
Delete an activity. Response 204: No Content.

item.name: Chat
item.description:
Chat endpoints — messages with reply support, read receipts (M7).

**Two-user flow:** User 1 creates trip & invites User 2 → User 2 accepts → **Send Text Message** (User 1) → **List Messages** (User 2) sees it → **Send Text Message (User 2)** → **Mark Chat Read (User 2)**.

**Multi-photo (FE pattern):** 1 photo = 1 message. Select 4 photos → send 4 POST requests; put caption only on the last one (`message_text` on final photo message).

**Auto-saved variables:** `message_id` / `message_id_2` from send/list; `cursor` from `next_cursor` when paginating.

query.description: Pagination cursor — RFC3339 timestamp from previous response `next_cursor` (e.g. `2026-07-13T04:28:14.108Z`). Leave empty for the first (newest) page. Enable this param only when fetching page 2+.

request.description:
List messages for a trip, **most recent first**. Participants only.

**Query:**
- `cursor` (optional) — copy `next_cursor` from the previous response to load older messages
- `limit` (optional, default 20)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "data": [{ "id": "...", "message_kind": "text", "message_text": "...", "is_deleted": false, ... }],
  "next_cursor": "2026-07-13T04:28:14.108Z"
}
```

Test script auto-saves `message_id` (newest) and `cursor` when present.

query.description: RFC3339 timestamp from `next_cursor` — enable only for page 2+

request.description: List messages **as User 2** (`{{access_token_2}}`). Use after User 1 sends a message to verify both participants can read the thread. User 2 must be a trip participant (accept invitation first).

Send a text message as **User 1**.

**Body:**
- `message_kind` (required) — `"text"`
- `message_text` (required for text) — message content
- `reply_to_id` (optional) — UUID of message to reply to

**Response 201:** Message object. Saves `message_id` automatically.
Send a text message **as User 2** (`{{access_token_2}}`). User 2 must be a trip participant.

Send a **single** photo message (User 1). Auto-inserts `trip_documents` with `from_chat=true`.

**Body:**
- `message_kind` — `"photo"` or `"video"`
- `media_url` (required) — public CDN/R2 URL of the uploaded file
- `message_text` (optional) — caption; typically only on the **last** photo when sending multiple

**Multi-photo:** duplicate this request per photo (change `media_url`). No backend batch endpoint — FE sends N requests.

For real R2 uploads use **Send Photo Message (R2 URL)** after the Uploads flow.

Send a chat photo using a **real R2 public URL** (`{{media_public_url}}`).

**Prerequisite:** Run **Uploads → 1. Presign** → **2. Upload File to R2 (PUT)** first (register optional — chat auto-creates `trip_documents` with `from_chat=true`).

Confirms chat media + Media tab integration with actual stored files.
Example of the **last photo in a multi-photo send** with caption on the final message only (recommended FE pattern). Run **Send Photo Message** 3× without caption, then this request as the 4th.

Reply to another message.

**Body:**
- `reply_to_id` — UUID of the message being quoted (use `{{message_id}}` from List/Send)

Response embeds `reply_to` with sender + preview text.

Advance **User 1's** read cursor (`trip_message_reads.last_read_at`). Used for unread badge — messages with `created_at` after this timestamp count as unread.

**Response 204:** No Content.
Advance **User 2's** read cursor (`{{access_token_2}}`). Each participant has their own read position.

Soft-delete **User 1's own** message (`{{message_id}}`). Sender only — sets `deleted_at`, content blanked in list (`is_deleted: true`).

**Response 204:** No Content.
Soft-delete **User 2's own** message (`{{message_id_2}}`). Run **Send Text Message (User 2)** first to populate `message_id_2`.

item.name: Media
item.description:
Media upload/register/cover endpoints (M7).

**R2 flow:** See **Uploads** folder (steps 1→2→3), then **Register Document** here, then **List Documents** / **Set Trip Cover**.

Chat photos uploaded via R2 can skip Register — use **Chat → Send Photo Message (R2 URL)** instead (auto `from_chat` document).

request.description:
List all media for a trip (Media tab). Includes chat-sourced items (`from_chat: true`).

Test script auto-saves `document_id` from the newest item.

**Response 200:**
```json
{ "data": [{ "id": "...", "url": "...", "is_cover": false, "from_chat": true, ... }] }
```
List media **as User 2** — verify participant access after chat photos or registered uploads.

Register an object **already uploaded to R2** as a `trip_documents` row. Run **Presign Upload** first, PUT the file to `upload_url`, then call this.

**Body:**
- `storage_key` (required) — from Presign response, must start with `trips/{trip_id}/`
- `media_type` (required) — `"photo"` or `"video"`

**Errors:** `400 OBJECT_NOT_FOUND` if file not yet in R2.

Delete a document. Uploader or trip creator only. Clears `cover_document_id` references first.

**Response 204:** No Content.

Set trip cover from an existing document. **Trip creator only.**

**Body:**
- `document_id` — UUID from List Documents or Register Document

**Response 200:** Updated trip summary.

item.name: Uploads
item.description:
Direct-to-R2 upload (M7). **NestJS never proxies binary** — the file goes straight to Cloudflare R2.

## Full flow (run in order)
1. **Presign Upload** — get `upload_url`, `storage_key`, `public_url`
2. **Upload File to R2 (PUT)** — select a `.jpg` file in Body → binary; `Content-Type` must match presign
3. **Media → Register Document** — verify object in R2 + save DB row
4. **Media → List Documents** — confirm `url` is fetchable
5. *(optional)* **Chat → Send Photo Message (R2 URL)** — chat + auto `from_chat` document

Requires valid `R2_*` in `backend/.env` and R2 bucket public access via `R2_PUBLIC_URL`.

request.description:
**Step 1** — Issue a presigned R2 PUT URL (5 min expiry). Participants only.

**Body:**
- `trip_id` — trip UUID
- `media_type` — `"photo"` or `"video"`
- `content_type` — MIME type; must match the PUT upload header exactly (default `image/jpeg`)

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "upload_url": "https://...r2.cloudflarestorage.com/...",
  "storage_key": "trips/{tripId}/{uuid}.jpg",
  "public_url": "https://pub-....r2.dev/trips/{tripId}/{uuid}.jpg",
  "expires_in": 300
}
```

Saves `upload_url`, `storage_key`, `media_public_url` automatically.

header.description: Must exactly match content_type from Presign Upload — mismatch causes R2 signature error.

request.description:
**Step 2** — Upload raw file bytes **directly to R2** (not through NestJS).

**Setup in Postman:**
1. Run **1. Presign Upload** first (`upload_url` must be set)
2. Body tab → **binary** → **Select File** → pick any `.jpg` (or file matching `content_type`)
3. Send

**Auth:** None — the presigned URL embeds credentials.

**Response 200:** Empty body from R2 = success.

**Common errors:**
- `403 SignatureDoesNotMatch` — `Content-Type` header doesn't match presign
- `403 ExpiredToken` — presign older than 5 minutes; re-run step 1

Next: **Media → Register Document**

**Step 2b (optional)** — Verify the uploaded file is publicly readable via `R2_PUBLIC_URL`.

Run after **Upload File to R2 (PUT)**. Uses `{{media_public_url}}` from presign/register response.

If this fails with 404, enable public access on your R2 bucket custom domain / r2.dev URL in Cloudflare dashboard.
